name: animated-drawer
title: Animated Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the edge and can be swiped away.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, drawer included. Its primary colour fills the main button and the hover fill.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: The trigger and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: fillOnHover
props.label: Fill on hover
props.description: Buttons fill with colour from the edge on hover.

props.name: side
props.label: Side
props.description: Which edge of the screen the drawer slides in from.

props.name: showSwipeHandle
props.label: Swipe handle
props.description: Shows a handle you can grab to swipe the drawer away.

props.name: openAnimation
props.label: Opens with
props.description: How the drawer arrives: slides in or fades in.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: The drawer springs in with a slight overshoot.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: How much the drawer overshoots and settles. 0 is no bounce.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between each piece of drawer content appearing, in seconds.

props.name: tiltOnSwipe
props.label: Tilt on swipe
props.description: The drawer tilts slightly as you swipe it.

props.name: scaleBackground
props.label: Shrink page behind
props.description: The page behind shrinks a little while the drawer is open.
